reviews.overall: Em viết đúng đề, đủ số từ và chia hai đoạn Detail theo mốc 2006; phần lớn số liệu được đối chiếu đúng. Tuy nhiên, Overview chưa nêu diễn biến tăng rồi giảm của Thailand, dù đây là đặc điểm chính. Câu cuối gọi 999,963 là số cao nhất toàn bảng, trong khi đỉnh là 1,162,356 vào năm 2006. Bài này em cũng cần soát kỹ phần nối câu “timelineBetween”, cách dùng “likewise” và dấu chấm cuối ba đoạn đầu. Cô yêu cầu em sửa các chỗ đó rồi nộp lại.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em chia Detail theo 2003–2006 và 2006–2009, đúng với bước ngoặt năm 2006 của Thailand; mỗi đoạn có hơn hai câu. Cách chia này giúp em so sánh ba nước ở từng giai đoạn. Khi viết lại Overview, em cần nêu đủ chiều biến động của cả ba nước, đặc biệt là đỉnh của Thailand vào năm 2006.

reviews.originalEssay:
The given table illustrates how many cars were manufactured in Argentina, Australia, and Thailand in three different years , over  a period of 6 years , commencing in 2003 
Overall, there was a general decrease in the number of cars produced in Australia, whereas an opposite trend was observed in Argentina. Meanwhile, Thailand consistently accounted for the highest car production figures throughout the given period
To elaborate, in 2003, exactly 452,163 cars were manufactured in Australia. However, this figure experienced a gradual decrease to 341,268 in 2006. Conversely, the figures for Argentina and Thailand witnessed a rise, jumping from 235,088 and 735,852 to 352,759 and 1,162,356 respectively
Regarding the latter half of the provided  timelineBetween 2006 and 2009, the number of cars made in Australia continued to fall, reaching a low of 245,624 in 2009. An upward trend was likewise recorded for Argentina, as its production rose to 466,089. Finally, although the number of cars produced in Thailand dropped to 999,963 in 2009, it still remained the highest figure in the table.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The table compares the number of cars manufactured in Argentina, Australia and Thailand in 2003, 2006 and 2009.

Overall, car production increased steadily in Argentina but declined throughout the period in Australia. Thailand remained the largest producer in all three years, rising to a peak in 2006 before falling in 2009. By 2006, Argentina had also overtaken Australia.

In 2003, Australia produced 452,163 cars, nearly twice Argentina's figure of 235,088, while Thailand made 735,852. Three years later, Australia's total had fallen to 341,268. By contrast, Argentina's output had risen to 352,759, putting it slightly ahead of Australia, and Thailand's figure had jumped to 1,162,356, the highest value in the table.

From 2006 to 2009, the number of cars produced in Australia fell further to 245,624, whereas Argentina's total climbed to 466,089. Thailand's output decreased from its 2006 peak to 999,963 cars. Despite this drop, Thailand still produced more cars than either Argentina or Australia in 2009, and its final figure remained above its 2003 level.

The two line charts show how many men and women were held in prison in a European country from 1911 to 2001.

Overall, the male prison population exceeded the female population throughout the period. The number of male prisoners fell initially but then rose, with a particularly sharp increase between 1971 and 1981. By contrast, the female figure fell to a low around 1941, then fluctuated and partly recovered, but finished below its 1911 level.

In 1911, there were approximately 18,000 male prisoners, and this number remained stable in 1921. It then fell to a low of about 10,000 in 1931 before returning to nearly 20,000 by 1951. After staying close to that level until 1971, the figure jumped to roughly 39,000 in 1981 and rose more gradually to around 46,000 in 2001.

The female prison population began at about 3,200 in 1911, its highest level. It fell steadily to approximately 500 in 1941, then recovered to around 1,500 in 1961 before dropping again to about 700 in 1971. From that point, the figure climbed consistently, reaching around 1,900 by 2001, still below its initial level.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The line graph compares weekly consumption of chicken, beef, lamb and fish in a European country from 1979 to 2004, measured in grams per person.

Overall, chicken consumption rose considerably and overtook beef around 1989 to become the highest by the end of the period. In contrast, beef and lamb consumption declined substantially, whereas fish remained the least consumed food and fell only slightly.

In 1979, beef consumption was about 220 grams per person per week, compared with roughly 140 grams for chicken. Beef fluctuated and reached a peak of around 240 grams in the early 1980s, before falling to approximately 110 grams in 2004. Chicken consumption, meanwhile, increased with small fluctuations, passing beef at about 200 grams in 1989 and finishing at roughly 250 grams.

Lamb started at around 150 grams per person per week and, despite occasional small rises, dropped to about 55 grams in 2004. The figure for fish was much lower, at approximately 60 grams initially. It then declined gradually to around 35 grams, remaining below the figures for the three meats throughout the period.

Tuy nhiên, Overview nói cả bốn nước đều tăng, trong khi B trở về đúng mức ban đầu; đây là nhận định chính cần sửa. Introduction còn lặp gần nguyên cụm mô tả của đề. Bài này em soát chưa kỹ các dạng động từ và từ loại trong Detail; Cô yêu cầu em sửa những chỗ được đánh dấu, rồi kiểm tra lại dấu câu.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em dành Detail 1 cho D và A, hai nước tăng rõ; Detail 2 cho C tăng nhẹ và B giảm rồi phục hồi. Cách chia theo nhóm xu hướng phù hợp với bài bốn đối tượng và em đã trình bày trọn ba mốc của từng nước. Em mới so sánh trực tiếp D với các nước khác ở Overview; trong Details, em có thể làm rõ A vượt C vào năm 2010 và B trở lại bằng mức năm 2000.

reviews.originalEssay:
The bar chart illustrates the percentages of young people in higher education in four different countries , over a period of 10 years , commencing from 2000
Overall , there was a general increase in the proportion of young people in higher education in four countries , with Country D consistently recording the highest figures throughout the given period 
To elaborate, Country D started at 60% in 2000, rise to 65% in 2005, and reached a peak of 80% by 2010. Similarly, Country A saw a remark growth from approximately 37% in 2000 to nearly 48% in 2005, before surging to close to 58% at the end of the given period 
Regarding Country C, the percentage of young people in higher education remained relatively stable, starting at 50% in 2000, experiencing a slight increase to 52% in 2005, and finishing at roughly 53% in 2010. Finally, Country B was the only nation to show a slight reduced ,  fluctuating from 40% in 2000 down to 38% in 2005 before recovery slightly to 40% in 2010.

reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn đoạn, mô tả đúng đại lượng là tỷ lệ phần trăm nữ nghị sĩ và nhận ra mức tăng mạnh nhất của UK. Tuy nhiên, em bỏ hẳn France, nên bài thiếu đỉnh khoảng 37% năm 2004 và diễn biến giảm rồi hồi phục của nước này. Overview cũng chưa cho biết Italy cao nhất và UK cùng Belgium thấp nhất vào cuối kỳ. Số liệu Belgium năm 2012 em ghi 31%, trong khi biểu đồ ở khoảng 28%. Cô yêu cầu em bổ sung France vào phần Detail, sửa số liệu Belgium và viết lại Overview cho đủ các đặc điểm chính.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em đặt Germany và Italy ở Detail 1, Belgium và UK ở Detail 2; nhóm này hợp lý theo mức cuối kỳ. Detail 2 vẫn trình bày Belgium trước UK để so sánh hai nước cùng khoảng 28% năm 2012.

Overall, in both years, suitable degree courses remained the most popular reason for choosing a university. The two pie charts show how the proportions of UK students selecting a particular university for five stated reasons changed between 1997 and 2007.

Overall, the percentages of students citing suitable courses, proximity to their parents' home and teaching quality rose, whereas those citing the quality of resources and sports and social activities fell. Suitable courses ranked first in both years. Proximity was the least common reason in 1997, while sports and social activities occupied that position in 2007. The former recorded the largest increase, and the latter the largest decline.

To elaborate, in 1997, 35% of students chose a university because it offered suitable degree courses, with the figure rising slightly to 37% in 2007. The proportion citing proximity to their parents' home more than doubled from 10% to 22%, while that for teaching quality increased from 15% to 18%.

Regarding the two declining categories, the percentage of students citing the quality of resources fell from 21% to 17%. The figure for sports and social activities dropped more sharply, from 19% to just 6% over the same period.
